notes: Starting the wrap-up used to delete the instructions between two frames. Now the panel collapses: its bottom edge climbs to where the title bar sits, dissolving the instructions and the Start button as it passes over them, and "Wrap-up" arrives just before it lands. The questions fade in once the panel has made room for them. Tap anywhere to skip straight to the end of it, and it is instant if you have animations turned off system-wide.
